title: Use a very simple prompt plus two reference images to guide Seedance 2.5 toward…
content:
Use a very simple prompt plus two reference images to guide Seedance 2.5 toward an avant‑garde “art house” style film.  
Generate at 480p resolution for a 3‑minute Seedance 2.5 video in Dreamina (expect ~4100 credits cost).  
Use Seedance 2.5 3‑minute generations as a brainstorming tool for scenes and edits, especially if you can tolerate continuation issues and basic audio.

es.content:

fr.content:

ja.content:

ko.content:
